ctx.x: with him, but he wasn't the leader when I was in the band. Edgar Willis was. But we had a great rapport.

Really, Leroy Cooper was one of my favorites among the sax that I did have, because he was just--why I lasted as long as I did, all along I would try to play for people. Now I liked when I had a musician if he was way out that was all right, but we're not going to do that all night, and I would try and look over the crowd; I would even have my book before I met the crowd to get all elements. So Leroy looked like he was a youngster but he could catch on to what I was meaning.
